First option outcome value (value): A dense map that needs calibration work. +2 dev insights
Second option outcome value (param): Officials trust certified numbers. +1 market insights

First option outcome status: You need hundreds of sensor boxes. You can build a small workshop of your own, or help a local electronics workshop become your supplier.
First option outcome value (param): Help a local workshop become your supplier
First option outcome value (value): A new business grows next to you, and others can buy from it too. +1 market insights
Second option outcome value (param): Full control, but a longer chain that only you can carry. +2 dev insights

First option outcome status: Your MVP can cover only one district. The city centre has many smartphone users. The private-house districts on the edge of the city breathe the worst air.
First option outcome value (param): Start where the air is worst
First option outcome value (value): Real impact, but fewer users. +2 product insights
Second option outcome value (param): More downloads, less impact. +2 market insights

First option outcome status: The city administration offers to pay for one month of exclusive access to your sensor data before it becomes public.
First option outcome value (param): Offer open data with public calibration reports
First option outcome value (value): Transparent, accountable and quality-checked: the akimat can rely on it, and so can everyone else. +2 market insights
Second option outcome value (param): Money now, but people lose their alternative source of truth. +400 money

First option outcome status: Users ask for alerts when the air becomes dangerous. A doctor warns that wrong alerts can cause panic, especially among parents.
First option outcome value (param): Add alerts only with a medical partner's thresholds
First option outcome value (value): Slower, but safe and correct. +1 product insights
Second option outcome status: Release alerts now with general WHO limits
Second option outcome value (param): A popular feature, with a risk of false alarms. +2 market insights

First option outcome status: To apply for DPG status, your code and sensor designs need an open licence. An investor wants the sensor firmware to stay closed.
First option outcome value (param): Release the app and firmware under the MIT licence
First option outcome value (value): Anyone can build and improve the sensors. Users are never locked to you. +1 dev insights
Second option outcome status: Keep the firmware closed for the investor
Second option outcome value (param): Investor money, but every user now depends on you alone. +500 money

First option outcome status: On release day, a large super-app offers to buy your project and turn it into one tab inside their app.
First option outcome value (param): Stay independent and open an API for every app
First option outcome value (value): Many apps can show the air map, so more people are connected to it. +2 market insights
Second option outcome status: Sell and become one tab in the super-app
Second option outcome value (param): Money now, but all traffic flows through one company. +300 money

Second option outcome value (param): Easy money, but the whole network now depends on one sponsor. +300 money
